name: MC_Stop
description: This Function Block commands a controlled motion stop and transfers the axis to the state ‘Stopping’. It aborts any ongoing Function Block execution. While the axis is in state ‘Stopping’, no other FB can perform any motion on the same axis. After the axis has reached ‘Velocity’ zero, the ‘Done’ output is set to TRUE immediately. The axis remains in the state ‘Stopping’ as long as ‘Execute’ is still TRUE or ‘Velocity’ zero is not yet reached. As soon as ‘Done’ is SET and ‘Execute’ is FALSE the axis goes to state ‘Standstill’.

input Execute BOOL Start the gearing process at the rising edge
input RatioNumerator INT Gear ratio Numerator
input RatioDenominator UINT Gear ratio Denominator
input MasterValueSource MC_SOURCE Defines the source for synchronization: mcSetValue - Synchronization on master set value mcActualValue - Synchronization on master actual value
input MasterSyncPosition REAL The position of the master in the CAM profile where the slave is in-sync with the master. (if the 'MasterSyncPosition' does not exist, at the first point of the CAM profile the master and slave are synchronized.) Note: the inputs acceleration, decelerations and jerk are not added here
input SlaveSyncPosition REAL Slave Position at which the axes are running in sync
input SyncMode MC_SYNC_MODE Defines the way to synchronize (like 'mcShortest'; 'mcCatchUp'; 'mcSlowDown'). Vendor specific
input MasterStartDistance REAL Master Distance for gear in procedure (when the Slave axis is started to get into synchronization)
input Velocity REAL Maximum Velocity during the time difference 'StartSync' and 'InSync'
input Acceleration REAL Maximum Acceleration during the time difference 'Start-Sync' and 'InSync'
input Deceleration REAL Maximum Deceleration during the time difference 'Start-Sync' and 'InSync'
input Jerk REAL Maximum Jerk during the time difference 'StartSync' and 'InSync'
input BufferMode MC_BUFFER_MODE Defines the chronological sequence of the FB. See 2.4.2 Aborting versus Buffered modes
output StartSync BOOL Commanded gearing starts
output InSync BOOL Is TRUE if the set value = the commanded value (is calculated set of values derived of master position and gear ratio.)
output Busy BOOL The FB is not finished and new output values are to be expected
output Active BOOL Indicates that the FB has control on the axis
output CommandAborted BOOL 'Command' is aborted by another command
output Error BOOL Signals that an error has occurred within the Function Block
output ErrorID WORD Error identification
inout Master AXIS_REF Reference to the master axis
inout Slave AXIS_REF Reference to the slave axis

name: MC_PhasingAbsolute
description: This Function Block creates an absolute phase shift in the master position of a slave axis. The master position is shifted in relation to the real physical position. This is analogous to opening a coupling on the master shaft for a moment, and is used to delay or advance an axis to its master. The phase shift is seen from the slave. The master does not know that there is a phase shift experienced by the slave (MasterPos as seen from the SlaveAxis = Physi-calMasterPos + PhaseShiftValueSlaveAxis, the phase shift value has the character of a position offset) The phase shift remains until another ‘Phasing’ command changes it again.

inputs.description: Start the phasing process at the rising edge

inputs.name: PhaseShift
inputs.description: Absolut phase difference in master position of the slave axis [u]

inputs.name: Velocity
inputs.description: Maximum Velocity to reach phase difference [u/s]

inputs.name: Acceleration
inputs.description: Maximum Acceleration to reach phase difference [u/s2]

inputs.name: Deceleration
inputs.description: Maximum Deceleration to reach phase difference [u/s2]

inputs.name: Jerk
inputs.description: Maximum Jerk to reach phase difference [u/s3]

inputs.name: BufferMode
inputs.description: Defines the chronological sequence of the FB. See 2.4.2 Aborting versus Buffered modes

outputs.name: Done
outputs.description: Commanded phasing reached

outputs.name: Busy
outputs.description: The FB is not finished and new output values are to be expected

outputs.name: Active
outputs.description: Indicates that the FB has control on the axis

outputs.name: CommandAborted
outputs.description: ‘Command’ is aborted by another command

outputs.name: Error
outputs.description: Signals that an error has occurred within the Function Block

outputs.name: ErrorID
outputs.description: Error identification

outputs.name: AbsolutePhaseShift
outputs.description: Displays continuously the absolute phase shift [u] while Busy is set.

notes: ‘Phase’, ‘Velocity’, ‘Acceleration’, ‘Deceleration’ and ‘Jerk’ of a phase shift are controlled by the FB.For comparison: MC_MoveSuperimposed could also be used to act on the slave axis. MC_Phasing acts on the master side, as seen from the slave

name: MC_CombineAxes
description: This Function Block combines the motion of 2 axes into a third axis with selectable combination method. Basically it is a calculation of a new position setpoint based on the 2 position setpoints of the input axes.This FB is reflected in the state diagram like a synchronized motion type. As application example one can work with a separate profile synchronized to an object on a moving belt, or a rotating knife with flexible covered distance to be cut.

inputs.name: Execute
inputs.description: Start the combination process at the rising edge

inputs.name: ContinuousUpdate
inputs.description: See 2.4.6 The input 'ContinuousUpdate'

inputs.name: CombineMode
inputs.description: Defines the type of combination applied to AxisOut :mcAddAxes : Addition of the 2 input axes positionsmcSubAxes : Subtraction of the 2 input axes positions

inputs.name: GearRatioNumeratorM1
inputs.description: Numerator for the gear factor for master axis 1 towards the slave

inputs.name: GearRatioDenominatorM1
inputs.description: Corresponding denominator for master axis 1

inputs.name: GearRatioNumeratorM2
inputs.description: Numerator for the gear factor for master axis 2 towards the slave

inputs.name: GearRatioDenominatorM2
inputs.description: Corresponding denominator for master axis 2

inputs.name: MasterValueSourceM1
inputs.description: Defines the source for synchronization for master axis 1:mcSetValue - Synchronization on master set valuemcActualValue - Synchronization on master actual value

inputs.name: MasterValueSourceM2
inputs.description: Defines the source for synchronization for master axis 2:mcSetValue - Synchronization on master set valuemcActualValue - Synchronization on master actual value

inputs.name: BufferMode
inputs.description: Defines the behavior of the axis: modes are 'Aborting', 'Buffered', 'Blending'

outputs.name: InSync
outputs.description: Is TRUE if the set value = the commanded value.

outputs.name: Busy
outputs.description: The FB is not finished and new output values are to be expected

outputs.name: Active
outputs.description: Indicates that the FB has control on the combined axis

outputs.name: CommandAborted
outputs.description: 'Command' is aborted by another command

outputs.name: Error
outputs.description: Signals that an error has occurred within the Function Block

outputs.name: ErrorID
outputs.description: Error identification

inouts.name: Master1
inouts.description: Reference to the first master axis

inouts.name: Master2
inouts.description: Reference to the second master axis

inouts.name: Slave
inouts.description: Reference to the resulting combined axis. Can be a virtual axis or linked directly to a real axis

notes: To stop the motion, the FB has to be interrupted by another FB issuing a new command
